problem: Goncharov conjecture on the cohomology of certain motivic complexes
missing_details: The base field F is arbitrary
Definition of the Bloch groups B_k(F)
Exact construction of the complex Γ_F(n) in degrees 1…n with its differentials
Precise statement that H^i(Γ_F(n))≅H^i_mot(F,ℚ(n)) for each i
Range of i (1≤i≤n) for which the conjecture applies
refined_question:
Let F be an arbitrary field and let n≥1 be an integer. For each k=1,…,n, let B_k(F) denote Goncharov’s k-th Bloch group over F, let F_ℚ^×=F^×⊗_ℤℚ, and let Λ^pF_ℚ^× be its p-th exterior power. Define the complex Γ_F(n) concentrated in cohomological degrees 1 through n by

Γ_F(n):
  B_n(F)
    → B_{n-1}(F)⊗F_ℚ^×
    → ⋯ → Λ^nF_ℚ^×

with differentials as in Goncharov (1995). Is it true that for each i=1,…,n the i-th cohomology group H^i(Γ_F(n)) is canonically isomorphic to the motivic cohomology group H^i_mot(F,ℚ(n))?
justification: The name indicates only a conjectural identification of cohomology of certain motivic complexes with K-groups, but omits all details of the field, weight, the specific complexes (Γ_F(n)), the Bloch groups B_k(F), the tensor/exterior powers, and the precise isomorphism to motivic cohomology groups H^i_mot(F,ℚ(n)).
